# Reports

This directory contains the evaluation report generated by the training script.

## Generated Files

- `evaluation_report.json` — Generated automatically by `python backend/train.py`

## Contents of evaluation_report.json

```json
{
  "best_model": "RandomForest",
  "evaluation_method": "Chronological train/test split (80/20). ...",
  "all_model_metrics": [...],
  "best_model_metrics": {...},
  "feature_importance": [...],
  "actuals_vs_predicted": [...],
  "hourly_summary": [...],
  "weekly_summary": [...],
  "volume_distribution": [...],
  "dataset_stats": {...}
}
```

## How to Generate

From the project root (with venv activated):

```powershell
python backend/train.py
```

This requires the dataset at `data/Metro_Interstate_Traffic_Volume.csv`.
See `data/README.md` for download instructions.
